p: the: Christ, declaring openly in an assembly by a notable miracle that he has power over the nature of things to feed man's body, leads the minds of all men to consider his spiritual and saving strength and power.
third day there was a marriage: After the talk which he had with Nathanael, or after his departure from John, or after he came into Galilee.
And when they wanted wine: Christ takes good enough care of our salvation, and therefore has no need of others to remind of it.
hour is not yet come: My appointed time.
waterpots of stone: These were vessels made for the use of water, in which they washed themselves.

firkins apiece: Every firkin contained one hundred pounds, at twelve ounces a pound: By this we gather that Christ helps them with one thousand and eight hundred pounds of wine. (about 135 imperial gallons or 600 litres Ed.)

well drunk: Literally, "are drunken". Now this saying, to be drunken, does not always refer to being drunk in the evil sense in the Hebrew language, but sometimes signifies an abundant and plentiful use of wine, which is nonetheless a measured amount, as in Ge 43:34.
And the Jews' passover was at: Christ being made subject to the law for us, satisfies the law of the passover.
And found in the temple those: Christ being ordained to purge the Church with great zeal begins his office both of Priest and Prophet.

zeal of thine house hath eaten: "Zeal" in this place is taken for a wrathful indignation and displeasure of the mind, brought about when someone deals wickedly and evilly towards those whom we love well.

Then answered the Jews and said: Against those who so bind God to an ordinary calling, which they themselves most shamefully abuse, that they will not admit of an extraordinary calling, which God confirms from heaven (and they would have it extinguished, although in vain) unless it is sealed with outward and bodily miracles.
sign shewest thou unto us: With what miracle do you confirm it, that we may see the heavenly power and strength which gives you authority to speak and to act in this manner?
temple of his body: That is, of his body.
But Jesus did not commit himself: It is not good giving credit to those who trust only because of miracles.
And needed not that any should: Christ is the searcher of hearts, and therefore truly God.
